snippet.title: Running a Cozy Shop for Adorable Animal Customers! - Psps Dream Mart (Demo)
snippet.description:
Build, manage, and optimize the coziest supermarket simulator! Set in a vibrant town filled with quirky animals. From placing the very first shelf to dodging bankruptcy, your goal is simple: turn a humble corner shop into the ultimate animal shopping paradise. 

****** 

Psps Dream Mart website: https://siv.games/psps.html
Psps Dream Mart on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4428210/Psps_Dream_Mart/
